title: FiniteLocallyConstantSetsRepresentability
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $E$ a sheaf of sets on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Suppose an etale cover makes its restriction on each member a constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and every separably closed geometric stalk is finite. Then there are a finite etale morphism $P\to T$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] and an isomorphism of its sheaf of sections with $E$ (equivalently an isomorphism of the underlying presheaves).

proof.text: Apply finiteLocallyConstant_exists_local_models to hloc and hfin to obtain a cover and finite constant local values.
Apply finiteLocallyConstant_descent_of_local_models to this witness, obtaining the finite etale representative and the required presheaf isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLocallyConstant_sets_representable
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (hloc : ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage T, ∀ i,
      (E.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)).IsConstant
        (T.smallEtaleTopology.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)))
    (hfin : IsFiniteSheaf E) :
    ∃ (P : Scheme.{u}) (π : P ⟶ T) (_ : IsFinite π) (_ : Etale π),
      Nonempty (E.obj ≅ uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj (Etale.mk π))
